title: Local complete intersection coordinate algebras on arbitrary affine opens
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $Z$ a scheme over $k$ [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose $Z$ admits an affine open cover $Z=\bigcup_{i\in I} Z_i$, where $Z_i=\operatorname{Spec}C_i$ as $k$-schemes and each $C_i$ is a finitely generated $k$-algebra which is a local complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Then for every affine open $W\subseteq Z$, its coordinate ring $\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_Z)$, with the $k$-algebra structure induced by $Z\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, is finitely generated over $k$ and is a local complete intersection over $k$. The empty scheme and the zero coordinate algebra are allowed.

source.place: Tag 01UG (lemma-local-complete-intersection), equivalence of (1) and (3), applied also to an affine open; Algebra Tag 00SH (lemma-lci-global), algebra.tex, equivalence of (1) and (2). The assumed affine cover makes Z locally of finite type over k, as required in the first lemma.
